# Illumia Solutions

> Enterprise-grade cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, open-source, and custom software development services for businesses across India, the USA, Australia, and beyond. Proxmox Silver Partner. Team holds CISA, CISSP, CEH, and CCIE certifications with 20+ years of collective industry experience.

Illumia Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is based in Kolkata, India, and serves clients globally with 24/7 support across multiple time zones.

## Cloud

- [Cloud Services](https://illumiasolutions.com/cloud-services/): Hosting, migration, storage, SD-WAN, and disaster recovery.
- [Private Cloud with Proxmox VE](https://illumiasolutions.com/on-premise-private-cloud-solutions/): On-premise virtualization built on Proxmox VE.
- [Cloud Migration Solutions](https://illumiasolutions.com/cloud-migration-solutions/): VMware-to-Proxmox and cross-cloud migrations.
- [Disaster Recovery](https://illumiasolutions.com/disaster-recovery/)
- [Virtual Private Server](https://illumiasolutions.com/virtual-private-server/)

## Cyber Security

- [Cyber Security](https://illumiasolutions.com/cyber-security/): IT risk strategy, application/cloud/infrastructure security, and compliance.
- [Compliance Services](https://illumiasolutions.com/compliance-services/): PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR.
- [SIEM as a Service](https://illumiasolutions.com/siem-as-a-service/)
- [EDR as a Service](https://illumiasolutions.com/edr-as-a-service/)

## Open Source

- [Open Source Solutions](https://illumiasolutions.com/open-source-solutions/): Collaboration, project management, email, and storage built on open-source stacks.
